summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for 'Explore the Distillation Tower', an interactive educational web application designed for ITE Chemical Process Technology students and created by Ms Syahirah. Includes interactive tower equipment exploration, dynamic vapour and liquid flow simulation, predict-and-observe conceptual experimenter, interactive labelling and quiz check with instant feedback, reflection prompts with export/copy support, and a built-in Teacher Review panel and pedagogical assumptions guide.
